scene.title: Scenes
scene.description: Build a timeline, evaluate frames, and export videos.

protein.title: Molecular structures
protein.description: Load structures, choose representations, and change coordinates or appearance.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Frame proteins and regions, orbit, zoom, and set depth cueing.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Move objects, change representations, and interpolate coordinates.

styling.title: Color and opacity
styling.description: Animate atom and residue colors and transparency.

annotations.title: Text and labels
annotations.description: Write text, label amino acids and nucleotides, and connect labels to regions.

regions.title: Selections and highlights
regions.description: Select atoms and residues and mark regions in 3D.

trajectory.title: Trajectories
trajectory.description: Read and align NMR ensembles, NumPy frames, and MD trajectories.

matching.title: Contact matching
matching.description: Match ordered Cα or C1′ subsets and save residue correspondences.

backbone.title: Backbone morphs
backbone.description: Move matched residues and fade unmatched parts between structures.

distances.title: Distances
distances.description: Measure atoms or residues with 2D or 3D lines.

interactions.title: Molecular interactions
interactions.description: Compute and display hydrogen bonds and screened Coulomb interactions.

rates.title: Rate functions
rates.description: Map animation progress to eased progress.

renderer.title: Rendering
renderer.description: Render frames directly with a reusable GPU renderer.

eevee.title: Blender EEVEE
eevee.description: Render through Blender with depth of field and smooth group fades.

properties.title: Numerical properties
properties.description: Map measured residue values to colors and cartoon thickness.

plots.title: Plots and sequence tracks
plots.description: Display time-series traces, contact maps, sequence strips, and color legends.

density.title: Density maps
density.description: Read MRC/CCP4 grids, extract contours, and animate slices.

nucleic.title: DNA and RNA bases
nucleic.description: Choose nucleotide base shapes and animate transitions between styles.

parameters.fps: Video frames per second; must be positive.
parameters.background: Background color as a hex string or RGB values.
parameters.target: Object to animate or use as a destination. The supported object type depends on the operation.
parameters.protein: Protein object to read or animate.
parameters.proteins: Protein or annotation objects to add or render.
parameters.run_time: Clip duration in seconds; must be positive.
parameters.rate_func: Callable that maps progress in [0, 1] to a finite value in [0, 1].
parameters.duration: Hold duration in seconds; must be nonnegative.
parameters.renderer: Existing Renderer to reuse; None creates and closes one for this frame.
parameters.codec: FFmpeg encoder name. auto tries H.264 VideoToolbox on macOS or NVENC elsewhere, then falls back to libx264 with a warning if hardware initialization fails.
parameters.progress: Print frame progress and render timing.
parameters.topology: Atom identities, residues, bonds, and chains in a Topology object.
parameters.xyz: Finite coordinates with shape (atoms, 3), in ångströms.
parameters.trajectory: Trajectory with the same atom identities and order; None uses the protein’s trajectory.
parameters.chain: Author chain ID or a collection of IDs; None selects all chains.
parameters.chains: Author chain ID or a collection of IDs; None loads all chains.
parameters.residues: Author residue number, inclusive (first, last) tuple, or list of individual numbers.
parameters.atoms: Atom name or list of names, such as "CA"; None selects all atom names.
parameters.path: Input or output file path, as specified by the operation.
parameters.kwargs: Additional keyword options described below or in the linked constructor.
parameters.axis: Nonzero 3D rotation axis; it is normalized internally.
parameters.opacity: Opacity in [0, 1], from transparent to opaque.
parameters.color: Hex color or RGB values. For tint setters, None restores the representation’s base palette.
parameters.resolution: Surface grid spacing in ångströms; smaller values increase detail and cost.
parameters.update: "rebuild" recalculates the surface as coordinates change; "deform" moves the reference mesh.
parameters.max_voxels: Maximum surface grid cells; increase this limit for large structures or finer grids.
parameters.atom_scale: Multiplier applied to element van der Waals radii for ball-and-stick atoms.
parameters.bond_radius: Covalent bond cylinder radius in ångströms.
parameters.assignments: One "H", "E", or "C" code per topology residue for helix, sheet, or coil.
parameters.margin: Positive framing margin; larger values leave more space around the target.
parameters.follow: Track the selection’s center after the focus completes.
parameters.theta: Change in horizontal camera angle, in radians.
parameters.phi: Change in vertical camera angle, in radians.
parameters.align: Align the destination to the source before interpolation.
parameters.atom_map: One unique target atom index per source atom; used with a Protein destination.
parameters.function: Callable receiving a copy of the coordinates and returning an array of the same shape.
parameters.start: Starting model index or ruler endpoint, as specified by the constructor.
parameters.end: Ending model index or ruler endpoint, as specified by the constructor.
parameters.state_easing: Callable controlling interpolation within each adjacent pair of trajectory frames.
parameters.region: Region selection attached to a protein.
parameters.residue_delay: Delay in seconds between successive residue starts.
parameters.value: Value to assign; the supported range depends on the property.
parameters.font_size: Font size in pixels at a 1080-pixel image height.
parameters.font: Bundled "regular" or "semibold", or a path to a TTF/OTF font.
parameters.position: Image coordinates (x, y), with (0, 0) at the top-left and (1, 1) at the bottom-right.
parameters.ligatures: Enable font ligatures during text shaping.
parameters.buff: Padding from the image edge in normalized image units.
parameters.camera: Camera used to project or frame objects.
parameters.offset: Offset (x, y) in design pixels at 1080p for residue labels; normalized image units for text shifts.
parameters.subtitle: Optional second line of text.
parameters.line_color: Callout line color; None uses the main text color.
parameters.line_width: Line width in design pixels at 1080p for overlays; ångströms for 3D highlight boxes.
parameters.clamp: Keep callout text inside the image bounds.
parameters.follow_opacity: Multiply annotation opacity by its selected atom opacity.
parameters.include_chain: Include the chain identifier in automatic residue names.
parameters.offsets: Map residue numbers or (chain, number, insertion_code) keys to label offsets.
parameters.avoid_overlap: Adjust labels in the group to reduce overlap.
parameters.lag_ratio: Delay between glyph starts relative to glyph duration; None chooses a value from glyph count.
parameters.stroke_width: Glyph outline width in design pixels at 1080p.
parameters.atom_indices: Nonempty collection of zero-based atom indices.
parameters.style: Highlight shape or line style; allowed values are specified by the constructor.
parameters.padding: Extra highlight size in ångströms. None selects a default for the highlight style.
parameters.other: Another Region from the same protein for a union, or an endpoint Region for a distance.
parameters.frames: Array or random-access sequence with shape (states, atoms, 3).
parameters.units: Input coordinate units: "angstrom" or "nm". Frames are returned in ångströms.
parameters.trajectory_file: Coordinate trajectory file accepted by MDAnalysis.
parameters.stride: Read every nth frame; a positive integer.
parameters.reference: Reference coordinates for alignment; None uses the first frame.
parameters.indices: Atom indices used for the rigid fit; None uses all atoms.
parameters.source_indices: Strictly increasing zero-based source topology residue indices.
parameters.target_indices: Strictly increasing zero-based target topology residue indices.
parameters.source_keys: Source residue identity tuples stored for validation.
parameters.target_keys: Target residue identity tuples stored for validation.
parameters.report: Dictionary with matching statistics, search status, and optimality information.
parameters.source_chain: Source chain ID; select one chain with protein Cα or nucleotide C1′ anchors.
parameters.target_chain: Target chain ID; select one chain with protein Cα or nucleotide C1′ anchors.
parameters.softness: Width of the soft contact transition in ångströms.
parameters.max_contact_error: Maximum discrepancy between matched soft contacts, in [0, 1].
parameters.search_seconds: Branch-and-bound time budget in seconds; preparation is additional.
parameters.max_candidates: Candidate correspondence limit; None searches all candidates up to the safety limit.
parameters.match: ContactMatch correspondence; None computes one using match_options.
parameters.fade_out: Normalized progress interval for fading unmatched source residues.
parameters.fade_in: Normalized progress interval for fading unmatched destination residues.
parameters.match_options: Options passed to match_backbones() when match is None.
parameters.mode: "3d" draws lines within the model; "2d" draws lines over the image.
parameters.anchor: "backbone" uses Cα for proteins and C4′/P for nucleotides; "ca" uses protein Cα only; "centroid" averages selected coordinates.
parameters.space: "model" uses local coordinates; "world" includes display transforms.
parameters.label_color: Distance text color; None inherits the line color.
parameters.precision: Number of decimal places in a distance label, from 0 to 6.
parameters.unit: Displayed distance unit: "Å", "nm", or an empty suffix. The distance property uses ångströms.
parameters.prefix: Text placed before the distance value.
parameters.show_distance: Display the distance value at the line midpoint.
parameters.dash_ratio: Filled fraction of each dashed segment.
parameters.donors: Donor Region or atom indices; None uses standard amino-acid and canonical nucleotide base templates.
parameters.acceptors: Acceptor Region or atom indices; None uses standard amino-acid and canonical nucleotide base templates.
parameters.hydrogens: "explicit", "auto", or "backbone"; controls the use of loaded or inferred hydrogens.
parameters.donor_h_cutoff: Maximum donor–hydrogen assignment distance in ångströms.
parameters.pair: Interaction record returned by this analysis.
parameters.charges: "formal" side-chain templates or one charge per atom, in elementary charge units.
parameters.screening_length: Positive exponential screening length in ångströms; None disables screening.
parameters.min_energy: Minimum absolute pair energy to include, in kcal/mol.
parameters.exclude_same_residue: Exclude pairs within the same residue.
parameters.allow_extra: Permit additional PQR records after every protein atom has an exact match.
parameters.energy: Pair energy in kcal/mol, or None for a hydrogen bond.
parameters.hydrogen: Explicit hydrogen atom index, or None.
parameters.inferred_hydrogen: Whether the hydrogen position was inferred.
parameters.points: Coordinates with shape (points, 3), in model ångströms.
parameters.chunk_size: Number of potential sample points processed together.
parameters.attractive_color: Color for negative electrostatic pair energy.
parameters.repulsive_color: Color for positive electrostatic pair energy.
parameters.show_distances: Display distance labels on interaction lines.
parameters.max_pairs: Maximum number of interaction lines displayed, from 1 to 2000.
parameters.require_metal: Require the Metal backend. None defaults to Metal on macOS unless a backend is explicitly selected; otherwise prefers a discrete GPU and Vulkan.
parameters.backend: Native GPU backend: Vulkan, D3D12, Metal, OpenGL or auto. None uses PROTEINMOTION_GPU_BACKEND or the platform default. Vulkan is the tested Windows path.
parameters.adapter_name: Case-insensitive GPU name/vendor substring. None uses PROTEINMOTION_GPU_ADAPTER or selects a discrete GPU when available.
parameters.readback_format: "rgba" for image arrays or "nv12" for video encoding.
parameters.exc_type: Exception type supplied by the context manager.
parameters.exc_value: Exception instance supplied by the context manager.
parameters.traceback: Traceback supplied by the context manager.
parameters.args: Exception information supplied by the context manager.
parameters.fstop: Lens f-number. Lower values produce a shallower depth of field. Must be positive.
parameters.blender: Optional Blender executable path. Otherwise use PROTEINMOTION_BLENDER, PATH or a standard Windows/macOS installation.
parameters.samples: Positive number of EEVEE samples per pixel; default 64.
parameters.supersampling: Spatial resolution multiplier of at least 1. Output is downsampled to the requested size.
parameters.max_blur: Maximum depth-of-field blur size in output pixels.
parameters.max_opacity_layers: Maximum distinct positive opacity levels per frame. Rendering cost grows with this count.
parameters.timeout: Seconds allowed for Blender startup or one frame before an error is raised.
parameters.executable: Optional Blender executable name or path.
parameters.vmin: Finite lower limit of the fixed color scale.
parameters.vmax: Finite upper limit, greater than vmin.
parameters.colors: Two or more RGB colors, interpolated between equally spaced stops.
parameters.values: Numerical input values; see the shape and missing-value rules for this object.
parameters.name: Measurement name for labels and legends.
parameters.scale: ColorScale shared by the structure, plots, and legend. None derives limits from finite values.
parameters.thickness: Optional (minimum, maximum) positive cartoon cross-section scale factors. Missing values use 1.
parameters.alignment: Region used to fit frames to the first sampled frame; defaults to backbone anchors (Cα for proteins, C4′/P for nucleotides).
parameters.times: Strictly increasing finite x coordinates, one for each value.
parameters.title: Text displayed above the plot or color bar.
parameters.xlabel: Horizontal axis label, including units when appropriate.
parameters.ylabel: Vertical axis label, including units when appropriate.
parameters.size: Plot (width, height) as fractions of the viewport.
parameters.ylim: Optional fixed (minimum, maximum) vertical limits. Defaults to the finite data range with padding.
parameters.reveal: Show only trace samples at or before the cursor.
parameters.grid: Show faint horizontal lines at vertical-axis ticks. Defaults to False.
parameters.tips: Draw small arrowheads at the ends of the plot axes. Defaults to True.
parameters.live_value: Optional pure function returning the measurement at current coordinates for the cursor marker.
parameters.first: First Region for a centroid-to-centroid distance trace.
parameters.second: Second Region from the same protein.
parameters.highlight_color: Color marking the selected residues in the plot.
parameters.min_separation: Exclude this many neighboring topology residues within a chain, plus the diagonal.
parameters.max_residues: Maximum polymer residues in a quadratic contact-map calculation; select a region for larger structures.
parameters.density: DensityMap supplying scalar values and map coordinates.
parameters.spacing: Positive scalar or (x, y, z) voxel spacing in ångströms for an orthogonal grid.
parameters.origin: Physical (x, y, z) origin of the first voxel, in ångströms.
parameters.basis: Optional 3×3 matrix whose columns are voxel step vectors in ångströms; replaces spacing.
parameters.periodic: Wrap sampling and crops at cell boundaries for a full periodic grid.
parameters.level: Contour value in the units chosen for this surface.
parameters.step_size: Positive marching-cubes grid stride. Larger values reduce extraction cost and detail.
parameters.bases: Nucleotide base style: slabs, rings, sticks, ladder, or none. None in Representation preserves the current style.
parameters.backbone_radius: Positive nucleotide cartoon tube radius in ångströms.
parameters.base_radius: Positive base-stick and connector radius in ångströms.

construct.description: Override this method to define the scene with add(), play(), wait(), and camera setup.

members.add: Add proteins, density objects, or annotations at the current timeline time.

play.description: Run animations together, then advance the timeline by run_time seconds.
play.notes: Animations that write the same object property concurrently raise ValueError. Create a new animation object for each play() call.

wait.description: Extend the timeline while holding the current state.

build.description: Call construct() once and prepare the timeline.

seek.description: Evaluate the scene at a time clamped to its duration. Supports forward and backward seeks.

render_frame.description: Render an RGBA frame and optionally save it as an image.

members.render: Render the current scene or frame with the selected output settings.

preview.description: Open an interactive preview window. Requires the preview extra.

from_file.description: Load PDB or mmCIF coordinates and retain all models with matching atom identities.
from_file.notes: Keyword options: chains=None, include_water=False, include_hydrogens=False. Other hetero atoms are retained.

from_trajectory.description: Create a protein from the trajectory’s topology and first frame.

select.description: Select atoms by author chain, residue number, and atom name.
select.notes: A residue tuple is an inclusive range. A list selects individual numbers. Empty selections raise ValueError.

label_residues.description: Create labels for the selected residues. Extra options go to ResidueLabels.

hydrogen_bonds.description: Create a hydrogen-bond analysis. Options go to HydrogenBonds.

electrostatics.description: Create a screened Coulomb analysis. Options go to Electrostatics.

positions.description: Current atom coordinates in the protein’s local coordinate frame.
positions.returns: Array with shape (selected atoms, 3), in ångströms.

members.atom_progress: Current interpolation fraction for each atom.
members.atom_opacities: Current per-atom opacity, including global opacity and residue fades.

set_positions.description: Replace coordinates while preserving atom identities and topology.

copy.description: Copy the protein’s current state for independent animation; topology and trajectory are shared.

center.description: Move the molecular centroid to the world origin.

shift.description: Translate the object by an offset.

set_color.description: Apply a tint across all representations. None restores the base palette.
set_color.returns: The object or a Colorize animation.

color_residues.description: Apply a tint to the selected residues in every representation.

set_residue_opacity.description: Set opacity on the selected residues.

surface.description: Show a van der Waals, solvent-accessible, or voxel solvent-excluded surface.
surface.notes: Additional option: max_voxels=8000000 limits the grid size. Configure surface settings before the first play() call. The ses surface is a voxel approximation.

parameters.color: Palette: secondary, base, rainbow, chain, or a fixed color. Surfaces also accept element.

cartoon.description: Show protein secondary structure and nucleotide backbone tubes with selectable base shapes.

parameters.color: Palette: secondary, base, rainbow, chain, or a fixed color. Surfaces also accept element.
Palette: secondary, base, rainbow, chain, or a fixed color. Surfaces also accept element.

ball_and_stick.description: Show atom spheres and covalent bond cylinders, with element colors by default.

parameters.color: Palette: element, base, chain, rainbow, secondary, or a fixed color.

with_secondary_structure.description: Assign helix, sheet, and coil labels before adding the protein to a scene.

members.animate: Create a builder for fluent animation calls. Pass the result to scene.play().
members.model_matrix: Current 4 × 4 transform from local to world coordinates.

snapshot.description: Capture the current state for deterministic timeline evaluation.

restore.description: Restore a state produced by snapshot().

members.frame: Frame the supplied protein objects immediately.

focus.description: Frame a protein or region and optionally track its moving center.
focus.returns: The camera, scene, or Focus animation.

update_tracking.description: Update the camera target from the tracked region while keeping zoom fixed.

orbit.description: Change horizontal and vertical camera angles.

zoom.description: Divide camera distance by factor. Values greater than 1 zoom in.

members.eye: Current camera position in world coordinates.

matrix.description: Compute the view-projection matrix for the given image aspect ratio.

bind.description: Capture starting values when the scene schedules the animation.
bind.notes: Called by ProteinScene.play(). An animation instance can be bound once.

members.targets: Objects whose state this animation changes.

apply.description: Evaluate the animation at eased progress alpha. Called by the timeline.

move_to.description: Set or animate text position in normalized image coordinates.

members.text_progress: Current reveal progress for glyphs and annotation lines.

set_text.description: Replace text and rebuild its shaped glyphs before adding it to the scene.

members.glyph_count: Number of shaped glyphs used for writing animation.

to_corner.description: Place text near an image corner.

layout.description: Project text and line geometry for the renderer at the current frame.
layout.returns: AnnotationLayout containing glyph placements and line paths.

parameters.progress: Optional reveal progress in [0, 1]; None uses the annotation’s current progress.

set_offset.description: Set or animate a residue label’s offset from its projected atom.

members.position: Translation of the parent protein in world coordinates.
members.world_positions: Selected atom coordinates after the parent’s display transform.

highlight.description: Create a 3D region marker or styled interaction lines.

distance_to.description: Create a ruler to another region. Extra options go to Distance.

callout.description: Create a label connected by a line to this region. Extra options go to Callout.

label.description: Create one amino-acid label. Extra options go to ResidueLabel.

__or__.description: Combine selections from the same protein with region_a | region_b.

__len__.description: Return the number of frames with len(trajectory).

from_npy.description: Open a NumPy trajectory using memory mapping.

from_mdanalysis.description: Read MD formats lazily with MDAnalysis. Requires the md extra.
from_mdanalysis.notes: Preprocess periodic boundaries before loading. Selected atoms must be grouped by residue.

aligned.description: Create a trajectory that removes rigid translation and rotation from each frame.

from_pairs.description: Create an explicit correspondence from at least three increasing residue-index pairs.

load.description: Load a saved JSON correspondence. BackboneMorph validates it against the structures.

save.description: Save residue correspondences, identities, and the report as JSON.

members.distance: Current endpoint distance in ångströms, regardless of the label unit.
members.pairs: Tuple of Interaction records recomputed when coordinates or analysis settings change.

hydrogen_position.description: Return the explicit or inferred hydrogen position for a detected pair.

from_pqr.description: Load exact-identity PQR charges and create an electrostatic analysis.

pair_energy.description: Evaluate screened Coulomb energy for two atom indices.

potential.description: Sum the electrostatic potential from all charges at sample points.
potential.returns: Array in kcal/mol per elementary charge.
potential.notes: Uses Plummer softening and includes all charges, independently of the pair cutoff.

as_dict.description: Convert the immutable interaction record to a dictionary.

draw.description: Draw a GPU frame without copying pixels to the CPU.

enqueue.description: Submit a frame and retrieve the oldest completed readback when the pipeline is full.
enqueue.returns: Frame array, or None while the readback pipeline fills.

drain.description: Yield all remaining queued frame arrays in submission order.

close.description: Release GPU buffers and renderer resources.

__exit__.description: Close renderer resources on context exit.

set_bases.description: Set nucleotide base shapes and optional dimensions before a scene begins. Use BaseStyle for an animated change.

parameters.style: slabs, rings, sticks, ladder, or none.

scene.ProteinScene.description: Define a protein animation as a sequence of play() and wait() calls.
scene.ProteinScene.notes: Subclass ProteinScene and implement construct(). Configure initial geometry, styles, and camera pose before the first play() or wait(). Concurrent animations can change separate properties.

render.description: Export the timeline to a video file.
render.returns: Dictionary containing frames, seconds, fps, platform, adapter, codec, and output. Here fps is render throughput; platform, adapter and codec describe the runtime selection.

focus.description: Animate camera focus using the scene’s output aspect ratio.

render_frame.description: Render one point on the timeline to an image.

parameters.renderer: "native", "eevee", an existing renderer instance, or None for native.

protein.Protein.description: A molecular structure with fixed atom identities, coordinates, and display settings.
protein.Protein.notes: Use from_file() for PDB/mmCIF or from_trajectory() for coordinate ensembles. Distances and radii use ångströms; rotation angles use radians. Immediate setters return the protein for chaining.

attributes.topology: Atoms, residues, covalent bonds, and chain segments.
attributes.trajectory: Coordinate states associated with this protein.
attributes.trajectory_frame: Current fractional trajectory state, updated by PlayTrajectory and restored by seeking.

animate.description: Create a builder for protein transforms, opacity, and color animation.

color_by.description: Apply residue property colors and optional cartoon thickness before adding the protein to a scene.

camera.Camera.description: A perspective camera with orbit, zoom, framing, depth cueing, and EEVEE lens focus.
camera.Camera.notes: Each scene creates its own camera at scene.camera. Use frame() for initial setup and Focus or scene.focus() for animated camera movement.

attributes.distance: Distance from the camera to its target, initially 70 Å.
attributes.theta, phi: Horizontal and vertical angles in radians.
attributes.fov: Vertical field of view in radians; initially 38 degrees.
attributes.radius: Framing radius used to choose clipping planes.
attributes.dof: Whether EEVEE depth of field is enabled; initially False.
attributes.fstop: Lens f-number, initially 5.6. Lower values produce more blur.

frame.description: Frame the supplied proteins or regions immediately and stop previous tracking.

focus.description: Frame a protein or region immediately and optionally track its center.

animate.description: Create a builder for orbit, zoom, and focus animations.

set_focus.description: Set lens focus without moving or zooming the camera.

parameters.target: Protein, Region, world point, or None to disable DOF.
parameters.follow: Track the mean selected position through motion; False fixes the initial world point.

set_focus.notes: Selectors apply to a Protein target. Ranges use inclusive PDB author numbers. atoms="CA" focuses on the Cα centroid. A region defines one focus plane, rather than making all selected atoms equally sharp.

animation.Animation.description: Base class for animations evaluated by the scene timeline.
animation.Animation.notes: Subclass Animation to define a custom animation. Declare the channels it changes, capture starting values in bind(), and implement apply(alpha). The scene rejects simultaneous writes to the same channel.

attributes.channels: Set of state channels written by the animation.

animation.Animate.description: Build a fluent protein or camera animation through the .animate property.
animation.Animate.notes: Protein operations include shift(), rotate(), scale(), and set_opacity(). Camera operations include orbit() and zoom(). set_color() returns a separate Colorize animation; focus() returns a Focus animation. Place color and transforms in separate arguments to play().

set_focus.description: Create a FocusPull animation for this camera.

parameters.kwargs: FocusPull options, including chain, residues, atoms, fstop and follow.

animation.Rotate.description: Rotate a protein around its molecular centroid.

animation.Morph.description: Interpolate matching atoms to a protein or coordinate array.

parameters.target: Destination Protein or coordinates with the same shape as the source.

animation.Morph.notes: Inputs match atoms by chain, residue number, insertion code, residue name, and atom name. atom_map can supply an explicit one-to-one mapping. Raw arrays use source atom order. Alignment uses Cα for proteins and C1′ for DNA/RNA. Nucleotide alignment requires at least three anchors; use align=False to preserve supplied coordinates.

animation.Deform.description: Interpolate coordinates toward the result of a user-supplied function.
animation.Deform.notes: The function runs when the animation is scheduled. It must return finite coordinates with the original shape. This operation creates an illustrative shape change.

animation.PlayTrajectory.description: Interpolate through coordinate states in a trajectory.

parameters.start: Starting frame index; may be fractional.
parameters.end: Ending frame index; None uses the last frame.

animation.PlayTrajectory.notes: Trajectory topology must match the protein. rate_func controls progress through the clip; state_easing controls interpolation between each pair of frames. Deposited NMR model order represents structural variation rather than measured time.

animation.Focus.description: Animate the camera to a protein or selected region.
animation.Focus.notes: Evaluated after molecular movement in the same play() call. follow=True keeps tracking the region center after the focus finishes.

animation.FadeIn.description: Fade a protein or annotation from transparent to its current opacity.
animation.FadeIn.notes: Set the desired final opacity before creating the animation. For atom or residue selections, use SetOpacity.

animation.FadeOut.description: Fade a protein or annotation to zero opacity.
animation.FadeOut.notes: For atom or residue selections, use SetOpacity.

animation.Representation.description: Transition between cartoon, ribbon, ball-and-stick and surface, with optional nucleotide base styles.

styling.Colorize.description: Animate a tint on a whole protein or a selected region.
styling.Colorize.notes: Residues start in topology order from N to C. run_time must exceed (residue count − 1) × residue_delay. Use easing for each residue transition; the clip clock stays linear. Disjoint atom selections can animate together.

styling.SetOpacity.description: Animate transparency on a whole protein or a selected region.
styling.SetOpacity.notes: Residues start in topology order from N to C. run_time must exceed (residue count − 1) × residue_delay. Use easing for each residue transition; the clip clock stays linear. Disjoint atom selections can animate together.

styling.RegionAnimate.notes: set_color() returns Colorize; set_opacity() returns SetOpacity. Their keyword options include residue_delay, reverse, and easing.

annotations.Annotation.description: Base class for text and lines drawn over the image.
annotations.Annotation.notes: Image positions use normalized coordinates. Opacity ranges from 0 to 1. Subclasses supply geometry through layout().

annotations.Text.description: Draw shaped vector text over the protein image.
annotations.Text.notes: Positions use normalized image coordinates. Font sizes use pixels at a 1080-pixel image height and scale with the rendered height. Text supports Unicode, ligatures, and TTF/OTF fonts.

annotations.Callout.description: Connect an image label to a selected region with a line.
annotations.Callout.notes: The label uses a fixed image position. Its line follows the selected region as coordinates or the camera move.

annotations.ResidueLabel.description: Label one amino acid at its projected Cα position.
annotations.ResidueLabel.notes: If the residue has no Cα, the label uses the selected atoms’ centroid. The selection must contain exactly one residue. Additional style options go to Callout.

parameters.text: Custom text, or None to use the residue name and author number.

move_to.description: This inherited method raises ValueError because residue labels follow their atoms. Set label offsets to change placement.

shift.description: This inherited method raises ValueError because residue labels follow their atoms. Set label offsets to change placement.

annotations.ResidueLabels.description: Label several residues and adjust their positions to reduce overlap.
annotations.ResidueLabels.notes: Options in kwargs go to ResidueLabel. Overlap adjustment applies within this group. Review label positions in the rendered scene. Residues without a Cα are skipped.

move_to.description: This inherited method raises ValueError because residue labels follow their atoms. Set label offsets to change placement.

shift.description: This inherited method raises ValueError because residue labels follow their atoms. Set label offsets to change placement.

annotations.Write.description: Draw text outlines and then fill the glyphs.
annotations.Write.notes: Works on text, callouts, residue labels, rulers, and interaction lines. Timing follows Manim’s MIT-licensed writing animation. lag_ratio=None chooses a delay based on the glyph count.

parameters.target: Annotation to draw: Text, Callout, ResidueLabel, ResidueLabels, Distance, or InteractionHighlight.

annotations.Unwrite.description: Erase glyph fills and then their outlines.
annotations.Unwrite.notes: Uses the Write constructor. Glyphs disappear from last to first by default; reverse=True changes that order.

parameters.target: Annotation to draw: Text, Callout, ResidueLabel, ResidueLabels, Distance, or InteractionHighlight.

annotations.AnnotationAnimate.description: Build position, offset, and opacity animations for annotations.
annotations.AnnotationAnimate.notes: Use annotation.animate. Text and Callout support move_to() and shift(); ResidueLabel supports set_offset(). All support set_opacity().

regions.Region.description: A selection of atoms that follows its parent protein’s coordinates.

attributes.residue_indices: Read-only topology residue indices represented in the selection.

regions.Region.notes: Create selections with protein.select(). Combine regions from the same protein with the | operator. Residue numbers in select() use PDB author numbering; atom_indices are zero-based.

highlight.description: Create a sphere, box, or atom highlight around the selection.

animate.description: Create a builder for residue color and opacity animations.

regions.RegionHighlight.description: Draw a sphere, wire box, or atom halos around a region.

parameters.opacity: Opacity in [0, 1]. None uses 0.9 for a box and 0.18 otherwise.
parameters.padding: Extra size in ångströms. None uses 0.3 for atoms and 2.0 otherwise.

regions.RegionHighlight.notes: The highlight follows the region’s coordinates and parent transform. Animate its opacity; apply movement to the parent protein. Highlight geometry describes a region boundary.

copy.description: Create another region.highlight() for independent styling. Calling copy() raises ValueError.

trajectory.Trajectory.description: A random-access sequence of coordinate frames in ångströms.

attributes.topology: Optional Topology shared by all frames.

trajectory.Trajectory.notes: All frames must have the same atom count and order. len(trajectory) gives the frame count. Input nanometer coordinates are converted to ångströms when read.

frame.returns: float32 array with shape (atoms, 3), in ångströms.

matching.ContactMatch.description: Store an ordered residue correspondence and its search report.
matching.ContactMatch.notes: Use match_backbones() or from_pairs() to create a correspondence. Both residue-index arrays are read-only. save() and load() preserve correspondence and validation identities.

matching.match_backbones.description: Find the largest ordered residue match under a contact-error limit.
matching.match_backbones.notes: Uses Cα for proteins and C1′ for DNA/RNA. Each input selects one chain with at least three anchors of the same type. Missing anchors are skipped. For equal-sized matches, the search minimizes contact-map discrepancy. Check the report for full-space, candidate-restricted, or time-limited optimality. The shorter chain supports at most 800 anchored residues; full candidate search supports at most 30,000 pairings. Reports include the anchor atom names, counts, and aligned_anchor_rmsd_angstrom.

backbone.BackboneMorph.description: Move matched backbone residues in order and fade unmatched residues.
backbone.BackboneMorph.notes: Matched residues move with their Cα (protein) or C1′ (DNA/RNA) in deposited chain order. Each move lasts run_time − (matched count − 1) × residue_delay seconds. Whole residues retain their internal geometry as source and target representations crossfade. Unmatched source and destination residues use fade_out and fade_in intervals. Both objects’ geometry, transforms, and opacity belong to this animation. Each endpoint selects one chain. Explicit pairs require the correct anchor atom.

distances.Distance.description: Draw a distance line between two atom or residue selections.
distances.Distance.notes: Single-atom selections use that atom. A single-residue selection uses its Cα when available; larger selections use a centroid. In 3D mode, atoms can hide the line. Labels are drawn over the image. Use space="world" for endpoints on separate proteins, and preserve a shared coordinate frame for physical distances.

interactions.HydrogenBonds.description: Detect hydrogen bonds from donor–acceptor distance and hydrogen geometry.
interactions.HydrogenBonds.notes: Pairs pass when 1.5 Å < D–A ≤ max_distance and D–H–A ≥ min_angle. Default templates cover standard amino acids. auto uses loaded hydrogens first and can infer backbone amide hydrogens. Use include_hydrogens=True when loading explicit H. For protonation-dependent or nonstandard groups, supply prepared coordinates and donor/acceptor selections.

highlight.description: Create styled hydrogen-bond lines. Options go to InteractionHighlight.

interactions.Electrostatics.description: Compute screened Coulomb pair energies and electrostatic potential.
interactions.Electrostatics.notes: Energy units are kcal/mol; potential units are kcal/mol per elementary charge. Formal charge templates illustrate charged side chains. Import atom charges for a prepared protonation state. This model uses a uniform dielectric and exponential screening.

highlight.description: Create styled electrostatic contact lines. Options go to InteractionHighlight.

interactions.Interaction.description: An immutable record for one detected molecular interaction.

parameters.angle: D–H–A angle in degrees, or None for electrostatics.

interactions.InteractionHighlight.description: Draw selected hydrogen-bond or electrostatic contact lines.
interactions.InteractionHighlight.notes: Hydrogen-bond labels use donor–acceptor distance by default. endpoints="hydrogen_acceptor" uses H···acceptor positions and distances. Electrostatic contacts use different colors for attraction and repulsion. Additional line options go to Distance.

parameters.region: Optional Region that filters pairs touching the selection.
parameters.color: Fixed line color, or None to use the interaction-specific colors.

interactions.charges_from_pqr.description: Match PQR charges to the protein’s atom identities.
interactions.charges_from_pqr.returns: Float array with one charge per protein atom, in elementary charge units.
interactions.charges_from_pqr.notes: Matching uses exact chain, residue number, insertion code, residue name, and atom name. Missing or duplicate records raise ValueError. allow_extra=True permits unmatched PQR atoms after every protein atom has a charge.

rates.linear.notes: Pass this function as rate_func to play() or an animation. Progress t is in [0, 1].

rates.smooth.description: Apply quintic easing with zero endpoint speed and acceleration.
rates.smooth.notes: Pass this function as rate_func to play() or an animation. Progress t is in [0, 1].

rates.ease_in_out_sine.description: Apply sinusoidal easing that starts and ends slowly.
rates.ease_in_out_sine.notes: Pass this function as rate_func to play() or an animation. Progress t is in [0, 1].

rates.there_and_back.description: Move smoothly from 0 to 1 and back to 0 over one clip.
rates.there_and_back.notes: Pass this function as rate_func to play() or an animation. Progress t is in [0, 1].

renderer.Renderer.description: Render protein and annotation objects with a reusable GPU renderer.
renderer.Renderer.notes: Use a with block to release resources. draw() submits GPU work without readback. render() returns one completed frame. enqueue() and drain() overlap GPU rendering and CPU encoding.

render.description: Draw one frame and wait for its pixel readback.
render.returns: RGBA uint8 array or NV12 array, according to readback_format.

parameters.background: Three RGB floats in [0, 1], such as scene.background.

draw.description: Draw a GPU frame without copying pixels to the CPU.

parameters.background: Three RGB floats in [0, 1], such as scene.background.

enqueue.description: Submit a frame and retrieve the oldest completed readback when the pipeline is full.
enqueue.returns: Frame array, or None while the readback pipeline fills.

parameters.background: Three RGB floats in [0, 1], such as scene.background.

eevee.EEVEEOptions.description: Configure the optional EEVEE renderer. Blender 4.5+ is installed separately.
eevee.EEVEEOptions.notes: Defaults use fixed sampling, 1.5× spatial supersampling, and scene-linear group fades. Each opacity level adds a render layer.

eevee.EEVEE.description: Keep one Blender process alive while rendering multiple frames.

parameters.options: EEVEEOptions instance, or None for defaults.

eevee.EEVEE.notes: Use as a context manager. This backend exports molecular geometry to Blender and composites vector annotations afterward.

render.description: Render current objects with EEVEE and composite sharp annotations.
render.returns: An RGBA uint8 array with shape (height, width, 4).

parameters.objects: Current Protein and annotation objects, such as the list returned by scene.seek(time).

eevee.find_blender.description: Locate the Blender executable and explain how to install it if absent.
eevee.find_blender.notes: Search order: explicit path, PROTEINMOTION_BLENDER, PATH, standard macOS application or newest Windows Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender <version>/blender.exe.

animation.FocusPull.description: Animate lens focus to a protein, residue selection or world point.

parameters.target: Protein, Region, or three world coordinates in ångströms.
parameters.fstop: Destination f-number, or None to keep the current aperture.
parameters.follow: Follow the selected atoms through motion. False fixes the destination at the start of the clip.

animation.FocusPull.notes: Uses an independent lens animation channel, so it can run with camera orbit or zoom. Requires the EEVEE renderer to show depth of field.

properties.ColorScale.description: A fixed linear scale mapping scalar values to RGB colors.
properties.ColorScale.notes: Values outside the limits use endpoint colors. NaN uses the missing color. Intermediate colors interpolate between equally spaced stops.

normalize.description: Clip values to [0, 1], keeping NaN for missing data.

map.description: Map values to an RGB array shaped (*values.shape, 3).

properties.ResidueValues.description: One measurement per topology residue, with identity checks and optional units.

parameters.values: One finite number or NaN per topology residue, including selected hetero residues.

attributes.keys: Chain, author residue number, insertion code, and residue name in topology order.
attributes.name: Measurement name.

from_mapping.description: Load keyed values using (chain, author number[, insertion code]); omissions become NaN.

parameters.values: Dictionary of residue identity keys and scalar values. Unknown or ambiguous keys raise an error.

b_factors.description: Read first-model B factors, or stored confidence values when the source file uses that convention.

parameters.atoms: backbone selects Cα for proteins or C4′/P for nucleotides. Also accepts an atom name, or None for the per-residue mean.

rmsf.description: Calculate per-residue RMSF in ångströms by streaming trajectory frames.

parameters.align: Fit each frame to the first sampled frame before computing fluctuations.
parameters.atoms: backbone selects Cα/C4′/P; an atom name selects that atom; None averages atomic mean-square fluctuations per residue.

rmsf.notes: Default alignment uses Cα/C4′/P anchors. Unwrap periodic MD coordinates before analysis. NMR RMSF describes variation across deposited models.

properties.ColorByProperty.description: Animate property-based residue colors and optional cartoon thickness.
properties.ColorByProperty.notes: Residue delays are in seconds. run_time must exceed total delay. The scale remains fixed during the transition.

plots.ColorLegend.description: A horizontal color bar with numeric limits and measurement units.

plots.TimeSeriesPlot.description: A vector trace with a cursor linked to scene time or a protein trajectory.

parameters.values: One finite value or NaN per time sample; NaN leaves a gap.
parameters.protein: Optional protein whose current trajectory state drives the cursor. Supply one sample per trajectory state.

plots.TimeSeriesPlot.notes: Without a protein, the cursor uses scene seconds. With a protein, it follows forward, reverse, and eased playback. Supplied samples remain fixed.

distance.description: Read a trajectory and trace distances between two selection centroids, in ångströms before scene transforms.
distance.notes: The marker measures the current interpolated coordinates; the line connects the supplied state measurements. Omitted times use state indices.

current_value.description: Live measurement, or linear interpolation of supplied samples at the current cursor.

plots.SequenceTrack.description: A sequence with a thin strip of current structure colors or a fixed numerical property.

parameters.region: Optional Region limiting which polymer residues appear.
parameters.selection: Region to mark with the highlight color.
parameters.values: Optional ResidueValues or one value per protein residue.

plots.SequenceTrack.notes: The same selection can mark residues in a 3D highlight and a contact map. Letters appear above the strip when space allows; selected residues have colored letters and an underline.

plots.ContactMap.description: A live binary backbone contact map with linked residue markers.

parameters.region: Optional Region limiting the rows and columns.
parameters.selection: Region to mark on the map edges.
parameters.cutoff: Maximum backbone-anchor distance in ångströms. Uses Cα for proteins and C4′/P for nucleotides.

matrix.description: Symmetric boolean contact matrix evaluated from the protein’s current coordinates.

plots.ContactMap.notes: Rows follow topology order and labels use PDB author numbers. Work scales quadratically; the default limit is 512 polymer residues.

density.DensityMap.description: An immutable scalar grid with physical coordinates and optional periodic boundaries.

parameters.values: Finite three-dimensional array in (x, y, z) order, with at least two samples per axis.
parameters.max_voxels: Maximum number of allocated grid values, default 32 million.

attributes.values: Read-only float32 grid in x, y, z order.
attributes.basis: Voxel step vectors as matrix columns.
attributes.mean: Mean of the source grid, preserved in crops.
attributes.std: Standard deviation of the source grid, preserved in crops.
attributes.periodic: Whether sampling wraps around the grid.

from_file.description: Read MRC/CCP4, optionally gzip-compressed, using Gemmi with map axes and physical coordinates preserved.

parameters.origin: auto prefers a nonzero ORIGIN field, otherwise grid starts; header or start forces that convention.

from_file.notes: Full crystallographic unit-cell grids are periodic. Cropped maps and EM volumes retain their stored extent. No symmetry expansion is performed.

slice.description: Create a trilinearly sampled, colored slice plane.

parameters.axis: Map grid axis: x, y, or z. In a skew cell these follow the lattice voxel vectors.
parameters.position: Fractional location along the selected grid axis, from 0 to 1.
parameters.resolution: Samples per edge of the slice plane: integer from 2 to 512.
parameters.follow: Optional Protein whose translation, rotation, and scale are applied to this map object. Density does not deform with atom coordinates.

parameters.units: sigma for mean + level × standard deviation, or absolute for a stored map value.
parameters.follow: Optional Protein whose translation, rotation, and scale are applied to this map object. Density does not deform with atom coordinates.

crop.description: Crop a box around a selected region in its protein’s local coordinates, with padding in ångströms.
crop.notes: Periodic maps wrap across cell boundaries. Crops preserve the original mean and standard deviation for sigma contours.

density.DensitySurface.description: A cached contour mesh with animated level, opacity, and transforms.

parameters.follow: Optional Protein whose translation, rotation, and scale are applied to this map object. Density does not deform with atom coordinates.
parameters.units: sigma for mean + level × standard deviation, or absolute for a stored map value.

positions.description: Eight map corners in local coordinates, for camera framing.

model_matrix.description: Map object transform, including its followed protein transform if present.

mesh_data.description: Evaluate or reuse the cached local-space vertices, faces, colors, and normals.

set_slice.description: Set a slice’s fractional grid position.

parameters.position: Fractional location along the selected grid axis, from 0 to 1.

animate.description: Animate opacity and transforms, or use set_level() on a surface and set_slice() on a slice.

density.DensitySlice.description: A trilinearly sampled map plane with a fixed color scale and animated position.

parameters.follow: Optional Protein whose translation, rotation, and scale are applied to this map object. Density does not deform with atom coordinates.
parameters.axis: Map grid axis: x, y, or z. In a skew cell these follow the lattice voxel vectors.
parameters.position: Fractional location along the selected grid axis, from 0 to 1.
parameters.resolution: Samples per edge of the slice plane: integer from 2 to 512.

positions.description: Eight map corners in local coordinates, for camera framing.

model_matrix.description: Map object transform, including its followed protein transform if present.

mesh_data.description: Evaluate or reuse the cached local-space vertices, faces, colors, and normals.

set_slice.description: Set a slice’s fractional grid position.

parameters.position: Fractional location along the selected grid axis, from 0 to 1.

animate.description: Animate opacity and transforms, or use set_level() on a surface and set_slice() on a slice.

protein.NucleicAcid.description: A DNA/RNA structure with base colors, nucleotide cartoons, surfaces and the Protein animation API.
protein.NucleicAcid.notes: Loads PDB/mmCIF or trajectories. The backbone uses C4′ with P as a fallback. Modified residues retain their deposited names and use parent-base annotations when available. Protein also draws nucleic-acid chains in mixed complexes.

cartoon.description: Show a C4′ backbone tube with slabs, rings, sticks or ladder rods. Pass the geometry options documented on Protein.cartoon().

parameters.color: Base palette: base, chain, rainbow, secondary, or a fixed color.

surface.description: Show a molecular surface using base colors by default. Pass surface options documented on Protein.surface().

parameters.color: Base palette: base, chain, rainbow, secondary, element, or a fixed color.

nucleic.BaseStyle.description: Crossfade nucleotide bases between slabs, rings, sticks, ladder, or none.
nucleic.BaseStyle.notes: Use inside scene.play(..., run_time=seconds). Coloring, residue opacity and backbone geometry use independent tracks.
